case.summary: Customer C07297 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $482.12 on card C07297-K1. An investigation uncovered a rapid burst of four unauthorized card-not-present transactions for product C on November 21, 2016, totaling $1,906.07. This online burst sharply diverged from the cardholder's baseline of 194 in-person product W transactions out of 199 prior purchases. Two transactions in the burst utilized device D001723 behind a transparent proxy, a device linked to 19 prior confirmed card-not-present fraud cases. The case was confirmed as card_not_present_new_device fraud with 0.97 probability, resulting in a card block and regulatory filing.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details card-not-present fraud affecting customer account C07297 and card C07297-K1 totaling $1,906.07. On November 22, 2016, the customer alerted the bank after discovering an unauthorized online transaction of $482.12 (transaction 3476682) conducted on November 21, 2016. A subsequent investigation revealed a rapid burst of four unauthorized online transactions for product C executed within a 30-minute window on November 21, 2016, between 20:00:00 and 20:30:00 UTC. The fraudulent transactions comprise 3476602 ($478.95), 3476633 ($456.96), 3476665 ($488.04), and 3476682 ($482.12), spanning billing regions 264 and 476. The cardholder's established historical baseline consisted of 199 prior transactions, 194 of which were conducted in-person and 194 for product W, demonstrating that this high-value online burst for product C was completely uncharacteristic. Transactions 3476633 and 3476665 were initiated using device D001723, which was newly registered to the card account and routed through a transparent proxy, generating elevated fraud model scores of 0.845 and 0.792. Historical case records confirm that device D001723 has been linked to 19 previously confirmed card-not-present fraud cases across the institution. The final transaction in the sequence, 3476682, shifted to device D000033 but remained part of the identical unauthorized transaction velocity. The bank has blocked card C07297-K1 to prevent further illicit activity and is submitting this report regarding the total unauthorized exposure of $1,906.07.

stop_reason: The investigation concluded under Policy Section 6 because the probability of fraud reached a decisive level (0.97) supported by multiple independent lines of evidence, including the cardholder dispute, severe divergence from baseline spending, and device D001723's documented history of 19 confirmed fraud cases. Further investigative steps would not alter the verdict or the required risk-mitigation actions.
